knowledge.summary_rw: Isi igizwe n'imigabane irindwi n'inyanja eshanu nini. Imigabane ni Afrika, Aziya, Amerika y'Amajyaruguru, Amerika y'Epfo, Antagitika, Uburayi, na Ositaraliya. Inyanja nini ni Inyanja y'Amahoro, Inyanja ya Atalantika, Inyanja y'Abahinde, Inyanja y'Amajyaruguru, n'Inyanja y'Epfo.
knowledge.summary_en: The Earth is divided into seven continents and five major oceans. The continents are Africa, Asia, North America, South America, Antarctica, Europe, and Australia. The major oceans are the Pacific, Atlantic, Indian, Arctic, and Southern Oceans.

knowledge.summary_rw: Isi igizwe n'ubwoko bw'ikirere butandukanye nk'ishyamba ry'imvura, ubutayu, na savana, buri kimwe gifite ibinyabuzima byacyo bwite bijyanye n'ubushyuhe n'imvura bihaho. Ibi bidukikije bifasha mu kurengera ubuzima bw'Isi.
knowledge.summary_en: The Earth features diverse climate types such as rainforests, deserts, and savannas, each supporting unique life forms adapted to specific temperature and precipitation patterns. These ecosystems sustain global life.

knowledge.title_en: Major Language Families of the World
knowledge.summary_rw: Imiryango y'indimi z'isi ni amatsinda y'indimi zikomoka ku rurimi rumwe rw'ibanze. Umuryango munini kurusha yose ni uwa Indo-Uburengerazuba n'Uburayi, mu gihe Niger-Congo irimo indimi nyinshi zo muri Afurika yo munsi ya Sahara harimo n'Ikinyarwanda.
knowledge.summary_en: World language families are groups of languages that share a common ancestral origin. The largest family by number of native speakers is Indo-European, while the Niger-Congo family contains the majority of languages spoken in Sub-Saharan Africa, including Kinyarwanda.

knowledge.summary_rw: Isi igabanyijemo imibibi y'igihe 24 bitewe n'aho igeze mu kuzunguruka kwayo ku zuba. Ibi bifasha abaturage ku isi hose guhuza amasaha agendanye n'umunsi n'ijoro. Umurongo w'isoko y'igihe utangirira i Greenwich mu Bwongereza.
knowledge.summary_en: The Earth is divided into 24 major time zones based on its rotation relative to the sun. This system helps people worldwide coordinate their daily schedules with day and night. The prime meridian for universal time starts in Greenwich, England.

knowledge.summary_rw: Guhinduranya imbuto ni uburyo bwo gutera ubwoko butandukanye bw'ibihingwa mu murima umwe uko ibihe bihunze. Bifasha mu kongera intungamubiri mu butaka, kurwanya udukoko n'indwara, no kongera umusaruro w'ubuhinzi.
knowledge.summary_en: Crop rotation is the practice of growing different types of crops in the same area across sequential seasons. It helps improve soil fertility, manage pests and diseases, and increase overall agricultural productivity.

knowledge.summary_rw: Ifumbire y'imborera ikoreshwa mu kongera intungamubiri mu butaka. Ikorwa mu bisigazwa by'ibimera n'amatungo. Ifasha abahinzi kubona umusaruro mwiza kandi yoroshye kuyitegura.
knowledge.summary_en: Composting improves soil nutrients using plant and animal waste. It helps farmers increase crop yields and is usually easy to prepare locally.

knowledge.summary_rw: Uburyo bwo kuhira imirima bufasha abahinzi guha ibihingwa amazi ahagije mu gihe cy'amapfa. Hari uburyo bwinshi nko kunyunyiza amazi cyangwa kuyayobora mu mirongo. Ibi bituma umusaruro wiyongera.
knowledge.summary_en: Irrigation methods help farmers provide sufficient water to crops during dry periods. There are various techniques such as sprinkler and furrow irrigation. These methods help increase agricultural yields.

knowledge.summary_rw: Guhitamo imbuto nziza ni ngombwa mu buhinzi. Abahinzi bagomba guhitamo imbuto zifite ubuziranenge kandi zitanduye indwara. Kubika imbuto neza mu hantu humye kandi hakonje bituma zitangirika kandi zigera mu gihe cy'ihinga ziri nzima.
knowledge.summary_en: Selecting good seeds is essential in agriculture. Farmers should choose high-quality and disease-free seeds. Storing seeds properly in a dry and cool place prevents damage and ensures they remain viable for the planting season.

knowledge.summary_rw: Isuri ni ikibazo cyugarije ubutaka bw'u Rwanda bitewe n'imisozi miremire n'imvura nyinshi. Ibi bitwara intungamubiri z'ubutaka bigateza n'inkangu. Leta n'abaturage bashyiraho ingamba nko gukora terrase na gahunda yo gutera ibiti kugira ngo barinde ubutaka bwabo.
knowledge.summary_en: Soil erosion is a major environmental challenge in Rwanda due to the country's steep topography and heavy rainfall. It removes vital soil nutrients and causes landslides. The government and citizens implement measures like radical terraces and tree planting initiatives to protect agricultural land and prevent environmental degradation.

knowledge.summary_rw: Gucunga imyanda mu Rwanda ni gahunda y'ingenzi yo kubungabunga ibidukikije. Leta y'u Rwanda yashyizeho amategeko abuzanya amplastike akoreshwa rimwe gusa. Hari ibigo bishinzwe gutondeka no gutunganya imyanda kugira ngo hatagira ingaruka mbi ku buzima bw'abaturage.
knowledge.summary_en: Waste management in Rwanda is an essential practice for environmental protection. The government of Rwanda has established laws banning single-use plastics. There are designated institutions responsible for sorting and processing waste to prevent negative impacts on public health.

knowledge.summary_rw: u Rwanda rufite urusobe rw'ibinyabuzima rutandukanye cyane. Harimo amashyamba yo mu misozi miremire, pariki z'igihugu, n'ibyanya bikomewe. Ibi byose bitanga ubuzima ku bwoko bwinshi bw'inyamaswa n'ibimera. Ibikorwa by'abantu n'imihindagurikire y'ikirere biri mu bishobora gushyira ubwo buzima mu kaga.
knowledge.summary_en: Rwanda has a diverse range of biological life. This includes montane forests, national parks, and protected reserves. These areas support many species of animals and plants. Human activities and climate change pose threats to this environment.

knowledge.summary_rw: Umwanda wo mu kirere ni igihe ibintu bihumanya ikirere byangiza ubuzima bw'abantu n'ibidukikije. Ibyo bintu birimo imyotsi y'imodoka n'inganda. Mu Rwanda, ubuyobozi bushyiraho ingamba zo kugabanya uwo mwanda kugira ngo abaturage bagire ubuzima bwiza.
knowledge.summary_en: Air pollution occurs when harmful substances damage the atmosphere, negatively affecting human health and the environment. Major sources include vehicle emissions and industrial smoke. In Rwanda, authorities implement measures to reduce air pollution to ensure public well-being.

knowledge.summary_rw: Ubwubatsi gakondo bw'Abanyarwanda bwafataga ibiti, ibyatsi n'ibyondo mu kubaka inzu z'umwirongi n'ibwami. Inzu y'Umwami yari nini cyane kandi ikozwe mu byatsi. Ibi byagaragaza ubuhanga bw'abakurambere mu gukoresha ibintu biboneka mu bidukikije.
knowledge.summary_en: Traditional Rwandan architecture utilized poles, grass, and clay to build dome-shaped houses and royal compounds. The King's palace was particularly large and constructed entirely from thatch and wood. This demonstrates the ingenuity of ancestors in utilizing local materials.

knowledge.summary_rw: Ubuvanganzo bwo mu kanwa ni ingenzi cyane mu muco nyarwanda. Ibyivugo ni ubwoko bw'ubuvanganzo buvuga ibigwi n'amateka y'umuntu cyangwa y'umuryango. Abantu babyivuga mu birori no mu gihe cy'intambara kugira ngo berekane ubutwari n'ishyaka.
knowledge.summary_en: Oral literature is very important in Rwandan culture. Ibyivugo are a form of poetry praising the achievements and history of a person or a lineage. People recite them during ceremonies and in times of war to demonstrate bravery and pride.

knowledge.summary_rw: Inanga ni umurinzi w'umuco n'umuziki gakondo w'u Rwanda. Ni igicurangisho cy'umuzika gifite imigozi ivuza amajwi yihariye. Abacuranzi b'inanga bacuranga baririmba amateka, imigani, n'ubuzima bw'Abanyarwanda kuva kera. Ubu buryo bufasha mu kubungabunga umurage w'igihugu.
knowledge.summary_en: The inanga is a traditional trough zither and a cornerstone of Rwandan musical heritage. Musicians pluck its strings while chanting historical tales, folklore, and poetry about Rwandan life. This musical tradition plays a vital role in preserving cultural history.

knowledge.title_rw: Umuco wo Kwakira Abashyitsi mu Rwanda
knowledge.summary_rw: Umuco wo kwakira abashyitsi mu Rwanda ni ingenzi cyane. Abashyitsi bahabwa ikaze n'icyubahiro. Gushyikirana no gusangira ni ibimenyetso by'ubumuntu n'ubucuti mu muryango nyarwanda.
knowledge.summary_en: Hospitality is a very important part of Rwandan culture. Visitors are welcomed with respect and warmth. Sharing food and conversation are traditional signs of humanity and friendship.

knowledge.summary_rw: Gucunga umutungo ni uburyo bwo gutegura uko amafaranga azakoreshwa mu gihe kizaza. Bifasha umuntu kumenya aho amafaranga ava n'aho ajya. Gutegura ingengo y'imari bituma umuntu abasha kwizigamira no kwirinda imyenda idakenewe.
knowledge.summary_en: Budgeting is the process of creating a plan to spend and save money. It helps individuals track their income and expenses. Effective financial planning enables people to build savings and avoid unnecessary debt.

knowledge.summary_rw: Umwenda ni amafaranga umuntu cyangwa ikigo gifata kuwundi muntu cyangwa banki, akaba agomba kwishyurwa hamwe n'inyungu. Kwishyura umwenda ku gihe bifasha kubaka amateka meza y'imari bikorohereza umuntukongera gufata inguzanyo mu gihe kizaza. Gicungwa nabi, umwenda ushobora guteza ibibazo bikomeye by'ubukungu.
knowledge.summary_en: Debt is money borrowed from a lender, usually a bank, that must be repaid with interest. Repaying debt on time helps build a good credit history and makes it easier to borrow in the future. Mismanaged debt can lead to severe financial difficulties.

knowledge.summary_rw: Serivisi za banki ni ibikorwa byose banki itanga bifasha abantu n'ibigo kubika amafaranga, kuyohereza, no gufata inguzanyo. Zirimo konti zo kubikamo no gusohora amafaranga, kwishyura fagitire, no gutanga inguzanyo zo guteza imbere ubucuruzi cyangwa imishinga y'abaturage.
knowledge.summary_en: Banking services are financial activities provided by banks to help individuals and institutions save money, transfer funds, and borrow. They typically include savings and checking accounts, bill payments, and loans to support business growth and personal projects.

knowledge.summary_rw: Ubwishingizi ni amasezerano aho umuntu cyangwa ikigo bishyura amafaranga ku kigo cy'ubwishingizi, maze icyo kigo kikishyura ibyangiritse mu bihe by'ibyago. Bitanga umutekano w'umutungo n'abantu. Hari ubwishingizi bw'ubuzima, ubw'imodoka, ndetse n'ubw'imitungo itandukanye.
knowledge.summary_en: Insurance is a contract where an individual or organization pays a fee to an insurance company, which then covers losses during unexpected events. It provides financial security for assets and people. Common types include health, motor vehicle, and property insurance.

knowledge.summary_rw: Mutara III Rudahigwa yabaye umwami w'u Rwanda kuva mu 1931 kugeza mu 1959. Yatanze u Rwanda ku Mana y'Abanyarwanda. Yateje imbere amashuri no kuvura abantu. Yatanze mu buryo butunguranye mu 1959 i Bujumbura. Urupfu rwe rwateje agahinda mu gihugu hose.
knowledge.summary_en: Mutara III Rudahigwa was the King of Rwanda from 1931 until 1959. He dedicated Rwanda to God. He promoted education and healthcare. He died unexpectedly in 1959 in Bujumbura. His death caused deep mourning across the country.

knowledge.summary_rw: Umugabekazi Kankazi yari umugore w'Umwami Yuhi V Musinga akaba na nyina w'Umwami Mutara III Rudahigwa n'Umwami King Kigeli V Ndahindurwa. Yagize uruhare rukomeye mu mateka y'u Rwanda mu kinyejana cya 20.
knowledge.summary_en: Queen Mother Kankazi was the wife of King Yuhi V Musinga and the mother of King Mutara III Rudahigwa and King Kigeli V Ndahindurwa. She played a significant role in Rwandan history during the 20th century.

knowledge.summary_rw: Imigani n'imigenurano nyarwanda ni ishingiro ry'umuco. Bitanga inyigisho z'ubuzima n'ubuhanga bwo kubana neza. Ababyeyi bayikoresha mu kwigisha abana imyitwarire myiza n'ubupfura.
knowledge.summary_en: Rwandan proverbs and wise sayings are a foundation of culture. They provide life lessons and wisdom for living harmoniously. Elders use them to teach children good behavior and integrity.

knowledge.summary_rw: Agaseke ni agatebo gakorerwa mu Rwanda kabohwa n'abagore. Kiba gifite umuryango n'umutwe w'ibuye cyangwa w'akarago. Koreshwa mu kubika ibintu no gutanga impano. Gihagarariye ubumwe n'amahoro mu Rwanda.
knowledge.summary_en: Agaseke is a traditional coiled basket woven by women in Rwanda. It typically features a conical shape with a fitted lid. Historically used for storage and gifting, the basket is a universal symbol of peace, unity, and reconciliation in Rwanda.

knowledge.summary_rw: Mu muco nyarwanda, abana bahabwa amazina n'ababyeyi babo cyangwa abavandimwe. Amazina akunze gufatwa hashingiwe ku bihe umwana yavukiyemo, ibyabaye mu muryango, cyangwa imiterere y'aho batuye. Kwita izina bisobanura kwakira umwana mushya mu muryango no mu muryango mugari w'abaturanyi.
knowledge.summary_en: In traditional Rwandan culture, children are given names by their parents or relatives. Names are often chosen based on the circumstances surrounding the birth, family events, or the living environment. Naming signifies welcoming the new child into the family and the wider community.

knowledge.title_rw: Amategeko ya Newton y'uko ibintu byigenza
knowledge.summary_rw: Amategeko ya Newton ni amategeko atatu y'ubumenyi bw'isi asobanura uko ingufu zikora ku bintu bituma byimuka cyangwa bikaguma aho biri. Yatangajwe na Isaac Newton mu mwaka wa 1687.
knowledge.summary_en: Newton's laws of motion are three fundamental physical laws that describe the relationship between an object and the forces acting upon it, and its motion in response to those forces. They were published by Isaac Newton in 1687.

knowledge.summary_rw: Uburyo bwo gucunga ububiko bw'amakuru ni porogaramu zifashishwa mu kubika, gutunganya no gushakisha amakuru mu buryo bworoshye kandi bufite umutekano. Zifasha abakoresha guhurira ku makuru amwe icyarimwe nta kibazo. Ibyamamare birimo MySQL na PostgreSQL.
knowledge.summary_en: A database management system is software used to store, organize, and retrieve data easily and securely. It allows multiple users to access the same data simultaneously without issues. Popular examples include MySQL and PostgreSQL.

knowledge.title_rw: Ibanze rya sisitemu y'imikorere ya mudasobwa
knowledge.summary_rw: Sisitemu y'imikorere ni porogaramu y'ingenzi iyobora mudasobwa. Ifasha porogaramu zindi gukora kandi ikagenzura ibikoresho nka processor na memori.
knowledge.summary_en: An operating system is essential software that manages computer hardware and software resources. It provides common services for computer programs and controls hardware like processors and memory.

knowledge.summary_rw: Mudasobwa igizwe n'ibice bifatika bitandukanye. Harimo processor itunganya amakuru, urwibutso rwa RAM rubika amakuru y'igihe gito, na hard drive ibika amakuru aramba. Hari n'ibindi nka motherboard ihuza byose n'amashanyarazi.
knowledge.summary_en: A computer consists of various physical parts. These include the processor that processes data, the RAM memory that temporarily stores data, and the hard drive for long-term storage. There is also the motherboard that connects everything and power supply.

knowledge.summary_rw: Router na switch niibikoresho byingenzi mu rusobe rwa mudasobwa. Router ihuza imiyoboro itandukanye ya interineti igaha buri mudasobwa inzira ikwiye. Switch yo ihuza mudasobwa zo mu nzu imwe cyangwa mu biro bigatuma zishobora gusangira amakuru mu buryo bworoshye.
knowledge.summary_en: Routers and switches are essential network devices. A router connects different networks together and directs internet traffic efficiently. A switch connects devices within a local area network, allowing them to share data directly.

knowledge.summary_rw: Guhisha amakuru ni uburyo bwo guhindura amakuru asanzwe akaba umubare udasobanutse. Ibyo bifasha kurinda amakuru y'ibanga kugira ngo abantu batabifitiye uburenganzira batayabona. Koresha imfunguzo zidasanzwe kugira ngo wongere umutekano w'amakuru yawe mu gihe uyohereza cyangwa uyabika.
knowledge.summary_en: Encryption is the process of converting plain text data into unreadable cipher text. This helps protect sensitive information from unauthorized access. Strong cryptographic keys are typically used to secure data both in transit and at rest.

knowledge.title_rw: Inzira yo gukora porogaramu za mudasobwa
knowledge.summary_rw: Inzira yo gukora porogaramu za mudasobwa igizwe n'intambwe zifatika zo gutegura, kwandika kode, no gusuzuma porogaramu. Iyi nzira ifasha abanyabugeni gutanga serivisi nziza mu gihe gito kandi zidakoresha amakosa menshi. Ibituma ikorwa neza ni ukumenya icyo abakiriya bakeneye mbere yo gutangira.
knowledge.summary_en: The software development life cycle consists of practical steps for planning, writing code, and testing software. This process helps developers deliver good services quickly and with fewer errors. Success depends on understanding client needs before starting.

knowledge.title_rw: Ubucuruzi bw'abacakara bwo mu Nyanja ya Atlantika
knowledge.summary_rw: Ubucuruzi bw'abacakara bwo mu Nyanja ya Atlantika bwabayeho kuva mu kinyejana cya 16 kugeza mu cya 19. Abantu baturutse muri Afurika batwawe ku ngufu ku Mugabane wa Amerika. Ibi byagize ingaruka zikomeye ku mibereho y'abantu no ku iterambere ry'ibihugu.
knowledge.summary_en: The transatlantic slave trade occurred from the 16th to the 19th century. People from Africa were forcibly transported to the Americas. This caused major impacts on human societies and national development.

knowledge.summary_rw: Ubwami bwa Kush bwari ubwami bukomeye muri Africa y'iburasirazuba, cyane cyane mu gice cya Sudan y'ubu. Bwateye imbere mu bucuruzi n'ubucukuzi bw'icyuma. Bwagiranye amateka akomeye n'ubwami bwa Egypt mu bihe bitandukanye.
knowledge.summary_en: The Kingdom of Kush was an ancient civilization in northeastern Africa, mainly located in present-day Sudan. It flourished through trade and iron production. It had a complex and often close relationship with ancient Egypt.

knowledge.summary_rw: Imari iciriritse mu Rwanda itanga serivisi z'imari ku bantu batagerwaho na banki zikomeye. Ibyo birimo inguzanyo nto n'ubwizigame bifasha abaturage kwiteza imbere no gutangira imishinga mito.
knowledge.summary_en: Microfinance in Rwanda provides financial services to people who are usually unreached by traditional commercial banks. These institutions offer small loans and savings accounts that help citizens improve their livelihoods and start small businesses.

knowledge.summary_rw: Ubwoko bw'ingenzi bw'ubucuruzi burimo umuntu umwe ubyikorera, amsosiyete y'abafatanyabikorwa, n'amasosiyete y'ubucuruzi afite imigabane. Buri bwoko bufite uburyo bwihariye bw'imisoro, uburenganzira, n'inshingano ku mitungo.
knowledge.summary_en: The main types of business ownership include sole proprietorships, partnerships, and corporations. Each type has specific tax rules, legal rights, and liability responsibilities for owners.

knowledge.summary_rw: Imisoro ni amafaranga yishyurwa Leta kugira ngo itange serivisi rusange. Ikigo cy'Igihugu cy'Imisoro n'Amahoro ni cyo gishinzwe gukusanya imisoro. Abacuruzi n'abaturage basabwa kwishyura imisoro ku gihe no gukurikiza amategeko kugira ngo birinde ibihano.
knowledge.summary_en: Taxes are compulsory payments to the government to fund public services. The Rwanda Revenue Authority is responsible for collecting taxes. Businesses and citizens are required to pay taxes on time and comply with regulations to avoid penalties.

knowledge.summary_rw: Inzira y'umusaruro w'ubuhinzi igizwe n'ibikorwa byose bihera ku ihinga kugeza umusaruro ugeze ku muguzi. Ibi birimo gutunganya umusaruro, kuwubika no kuwucuruza. Mu Rwanda, guteza imbere izi nzira bifasha abahinzi kubona inyungu no kugabanya igihombo cy'umusaruro.
knowledge.summary_en: An agricultural value chain includes all activities from farming to delivering the product to the consumer. This usually involves processing, storage, and marketing. In Rwanda, developing these chains helps farmers increase profits and reduce post-harvest losses.

knowledge.summary_rw: Serivisi nziza ku bakiriya ni ingenzi mu iterambere rya buri bucuruzi. Bisaba kumva ibyo umukiriya akeneye, kumutega amatwi no kumusubiza vuba kandi neza. Ibi bituma umukiriya agaruka kandi bikongera icyizere cy'ikigo.
knowledge.summary_en: Customer service excellence is essential for business growth. It involves understanding client needs, active listening, and providing prompt and professional support. This builds customer loyalty and enhances company reputation.

knowledge.summary_rw: Kubika ibitabo by'imari bisobanura kwandika amakuru yose y'amafaranga yinjira n'asohoka mu rwego rwo gukurikirana ubuzima bw'ubucuruzi. Ibi bifasha abayobozi gufata ibyemezo byiza kandi byorohera isosiyete kwishyura imisoro ku gihe.
knowledge.summary_en: Bookkeeping involves recording all financial transactions, including income and expenses, to track the financial health of a business. This practice helps managers make informed decisions and ensures accurate tax reporting.

knowledge.title_en: Major Mountain Ranges of the World
knowledge.summary_rw: Isi ifite imisozi miremire igabanyije mu migongo minini. Himalaya muri Aziya niyo ifite umusozi muremure cyane wa Everest. Imisozi nka Andes, Rocky Mountains, na Alps nayo iri mu zihagarariye Isi. Imisozi iterwa n'imbaraga zo munsi y'ubutaka.
knowledge.summary_en: The Earth features major mountain ranges formed by tectonic forces. The Himalayas in Asia contain Mount Everest, the highest peak globally. Other notable ranges include the Andes, the Rocky Mountains, and the Alps.

knowledge.summary_rw: Inzira z'inyanja n'imiyoboro y'amato ni ingenzi mu buhahirane bw'isi. Inzira nyamukuru zihuza imigabane. Imiyoboro nka Suez na Panama igabanya igihe cy'urugendo. Amato y'ubucuruzi yambukiranya inyanja buri munsi.
knowledge.summary_en: Major sea routes and canals are essential for global trade. Main routes connect continents. Canals like Suez and Panama significantly reduce travel time. Cargo ships cross the oceans daily.

knowledge.summary_rw: Gutekereza cyane bifasha umunyeshuri gusesengura amakuru no gufata ibyemezo bifatika. Mu mashuri mu Rwanda, abanyeshuri batozwa gukemura ibibazo bifashishije ubushakashatsi n'ubumenyi bwabo.
knowledge.summary_en: Critical thinking helps students analyze information and make sound decisions. In Rwandan schools, students are trained to solve problems using research and their knowledge.

knowledge.title_rw: Gucunga neza igihe mu gihe cy'ibizamini
knowledge.summary_rw: Gucunga neza igihe mu bizamini bifasha abanyeshuri gusubiza ibibazo byose uko bikwiye. Ni byiza kubanza gusoma ibibazo byose no guha buri kibazo igihe gihwanye n'amanota gifite. Ibi bigabanya impungenge kandi bigafasha umunyesuri kurangiza ku gihe.
knowledge.summary_en: Good time management during exams helps students answer all questions properly. It is usually helpful to read through all questions first and allocate time based on the marks available. This practice reduces anxiety and helps students finish on time.

knowledge.summary_rw: Ibikorwa by'inyongera ku ishuri bifasha abanyeshuri kwiga ubuhanga bushya. Bituma bagira imibereho myiza kandi bikabongerera ubushobozi bwo kuyobora. Ibyo bikorwa birimo imikino n'inteko z'abanyeshuri.
knowledge.summary_en: Extracurricular activities help students learn new skills. They improve overall well-being and usually enhance leadership abilities. These activities include sports and student clubs.

knowledge.summary_rw: Kwandika inyandiko nziza z'amasomo bifasha abanyeshuri kwibuka ibyo bize. Hari uburyo butandukanye bwo kwandika nka Cornell, amashusho y'ibitekerezo, n'urutonde rw'ingenzi. Gusubiramo izo nyandiko bikomeza ubumenyi.
knowledge.summary_en: Taking good class notes helps students remember what they learn. There are different methods for note-taking such as the Cornell method, mind mapping, and outlining. Reviewing these notes reinforces knowledge.

knowledge.summary_rw: Guteranya ni igikorwa cy'imibare cyo kongera umubare ku wundi kugira ngo ubone igiteranyo. Gukuramo ni igikorwa cyo kugabanya umubare ku wundi kugira ngo ubone asigaye. Ibi bikorwa byombi bifitanye isano ya bugufi kandi ni urufatiro rwa mathematika.
knowledge.summary_en: Addition is a mathematical operation used to combine numbers to find a total sum. Subtraction is the operation of taking one number away from another to find the difference. These two operations are closely related and form the foundation of mathematics.

knowledge.summary_rw: Alujebura ni igice cy'imibare gikoresha inyuguti kugira ngo zihagararire imibare itazwi mu muringanyize. Ingero z'imibare n'inyuguti zigizwe n'ibimenyetso n'ingana zerekana uburinganire bw'ibice bibiri. Gukemura izi ngero bisobanura gushaka agaciro k'inyuguti zitazwi kugira ngo urugero rube ruri ukuri.
knowledge.summary_en: Algebra is a branch of mathematics that uses letters to represent unknown numbers in equations. Algebraic equations consist of expressions and an equals sign showing that two amounts are equal. Solving these equations typically involves finding the value of the unknown letter that makes the equation true.

knowledge.summary_rw: Ishoramari ni ugushyira amafaranga mu bikorwa cyangwa ibintu kugira ngo bizatange inyungu mu gihe kizaza. Hari uburyo bwinshi bwo gushora imari nko mu migabane, mu mitungo itimukanwa no mu bigega. Gushora imari bifasha abantu kwiteza imbere no kwitegura ejo hazaza, ariko bisaba kwitondera ibyago bishobora kubaho.
knowledge.summary_en: Investing involves allocating money into assets or ventures with the expectation of generating a return over time. Common investment vehicles include stocks, real estate, and mutual funds. Investing helps individuals build wealth and prepare for the future, though it usually carries financial risks that require careful management.

knowledge.title_rw: Ubumenyi bw'Ibanze ku Misoro ku Baturage
knowledge.summary_rw: Imisoro ni amafaranga leta ikura ku baturage no ku bigo kugira ngo yubake ibikorwa remezo n'imitangire ya serivisi rusange. Mu Rwanda, Ikigo cy'Igihugu cy'Imisoro n'Amahoro ni cyo gishinzwe gukusanya imisoro. Abakozi n'abikorera bose basabwa gutanga umusoro ku nyungu cyangwa ku mishahara yabo mu gihe cyagenwe.
knowledge.summary_en: Taxes are compulsory financial contributions levied by the government on individuals and businesses to fund public infrastructure and services. In Rwanda, the Rwanda Revenue Authority is responsible for tax collection. Workers and business owners are generally required to pay income taxes based on their earnings.

knowledge.summary_rw: Imigongo ni ubugeni bwo mu Rwanda bugaragara cyane mu Karere ka Kirehe. Bwatangijwe na Prince Kakira mu kinyejana cya 18. Abagore bo mu Karere ka Gisaka nibwo bakora cyane bifashishije amase y'inka n'ibara karemano. Bakora imiterere itandukanye irimo amashusho y'ibyibonetse na geometric patterns.
knowledge.summary_en: Imigongo is a traditional art form from Rwanda, originating in the eastern region of Gisaka. It was founded by Prince Kakira in the 18th century. Local women create geometric patterns and designs using cow dung mixed with natural colors on wooden boards.

knowledge.title_en: King Rwabugiri and the Expansion of Rwanda
knowledge.summary_rw: Umwami Kigeri IV Rwabugiri yayoboye u Rwanda mu kinyejana cya 19. Yatsinze ibihugu bituranyi bitandukanye. Yaguye imbibi z'u Rwanda cyane mu majyaruguru no mu burengerazuba. Yashyizeho gahunda y'ubutegetsi bwakomeje igihugu.
knowledge.summary_en: King Kigeri IV Rwabugiri ruled Rwanda in the nineteenth century. He conquered several neighboring territories. He significantly expanded the borders of Rwanda to the north and west. He established administrative systems that strengthened the kingdom.

knowledge.summary_rw: Inkiko Gacaca ni uburyo bw'ubutabera gakondo bwifashishijwe mu Rwanda kugira ngo hacwe urubanza ku byaha bya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994. Zatangiye mu mwaka wa 2002 zirangira mu 2012. Zafashije mu kwihutisha imanza, kumenya amateka y'ukuri, no guteza imbere ubumwe n'ubwiyunge mu banyarwanda.
knowledge.summary_en: Gacaca courts were traditional community-based tribunals used in Rwanda to try suspects of the 1994 Genocide against the Tutsi. Operating from about 2002 to 2012, they helped accelerate trials, uncover the truth about the genocide, and promote national unity and reconciliation.

knowledge.summary_rw: Ubukwe bwa Kinyarwanda ni umuco w'ingenzi ugizwe n'ibyiciro bitandukanye. Hariho gusaba no gukwa, aho umuryango w'umusore ujya gushaka umugeni mu muryango w'umukobwa. Hakurikiraho gusezerana imbere y'amategeko cyangwa mu idini, hanyuma hakaba n'ibirori byo kwakira abatumiwe aho abageni bahabwa impano n'imiburo y'ubuzima bw'ingo.
knowledge.summary_en: Rwandan weddings are important cultural events consisting of several stages. There is the engagement and dowry ceremony, where the groom's family asks for the bride from her family. This is followed by civil or religious marriage, and finally a reception where the couple receives gifts and advice for married life.

knowledge.summary_rw: Ubuzima bw'umubyeyi bukubiyemo kwita ku mubyeyi mu gihe cy'inda, kubyara, n'nyuma yo kubyara. Mu Rwanda, gahunda zitandukanye zifasha kugabanya impfu z'ababyeyi n'iz'abana bato binyuze mu gutanga ubufasha bw'abaganga b'inzobere no korohereza ababyeyi kubona serivisi z'ubuzima.
knowledge.summary_en: Maternal health involves caring for a woman during pregnancy, childbirth, and the postpartum period. In Rwanda, various programs help reduce maternal and child mortality by providing skilled medical care and improving access to health services for mothers.

knowledge.summary_rw: Gukurikirana imikurire y'umwana bifasha kumenya niba umwana ari muzima kandiakura neza. Ababyeyi bajyana abana ku kigo Nderabuzima buri kwezi ngo bapimwe ibiro n'uburebure. Ibyo bifasha kuvumbura hakiri kare ibibazo by'imirire mibi cyangwa indwara zitandukanye.
knowledge.summary_en: Child growth monitoring helps determine if a child is healthy and developing properly. Parents usually bring children to a health center every month to measure weight and height. This helps detect malnutrition or various illnesses early.

knowledge.summary_rw: Konsa neza bisobanura kugaburira umwana w'uruhinja amashereka gusa mu mezi atandatu ya mbere y'ubuzima bwe. Amashereka aba yuzuye intungamubiri zose umwana akeneye kugira ngo akure neza. Nyuma y'amezi atandatu, umwana ashobora guhabwa andi biribwa ariko agakomeza konswa. Ibi bifasha umwana kurwanya indwara no kugira ubuzima bwiza.
knowledge.summary_en: Breastfeeding means feeding an infant with breast milk exclusively for the first six months of life. Breast milk contains all the necessary nutrients for proper growth. After six months, complementary foods can be introduced while continuing to breastfeed. This practice helps infants fight diseases and supports healthy development.

knowledge.summary_rw: Ubwami bw'u Rwanda bwari ubwami bwa kera mu karere k'ibiyaga bigari by'Afurika. Buyobowe n'Umwami witwa Umwami w'u Rwanda, bwari bufite ubutegetsi bukomeye n'inzego z'imiyoborere. Ubwo bwami bwaje guhinduka ubukoloni bw'Abadage n'Ababiligi mbere y'uko bubona ubwigenge mu mwaka w'1962.
knowledge.summary_en: The Kingdom of Rwanda was a historic monarchy in the African Great Lakes region. Ruled by a monarch known as the Mwami, it featured a centralized political structure and administration. The kingdom later became a colony under German and Belgian rule before gaining independence in 1962.

knowledge.title_rw: Uburyo bwo kwiga n'ubumenyi bw'umuntu kuri we ubwe
knowledge.summary_rw: Ubumenyi bw'umuntu kuri we ubwe bufasha umunyeshuri kumenya uburyo bwe bwo kwiga. Abantu biga mu buryo butandukanye, nko kwiga binyuze mu majwi, mu byo bareba, cyangwa mu bikorwa. Gusobanukirwa ibi bifasha umunyeshuri guhitamo uburyo bumufasha gutsinda mu ishuri.
knowledge.summary_en: Self-awareness helps a learner understand their preferred learning style. People usually learn differently, such as through auditory, visual, or kinesthetic methods. Understanding this helps students choose strategies that typically improve academic success.

knowledge.summary_rw: Ubugeni bwo kuvugira imbere y'abantu bufasha umuntu gutangaza ubutumwa bwiza kandi bwumvikana. Bugaragarira mu buryo umuvugizi akoresha ijwi, ururimi rw'umubiri, no gutegura neza ibyo agiye kuvuga ngo agere ku ntego yifuza.
knowledge.summary_en: Public speaking skills help a person deliver clear and engaging messages. This involves tone of voice, body language, and proper preparation to successfully reach the target audience.

knowledge.summary_rw: Uburyo bwo gufata mu mutwe bufasha ubwonko kwibuka amakuru vuba. Hari uburyo bwinshi nka gahunda y'ibimenyetso, gukoresha amagambo ahinnye, no kwibuka ibintu bifatika. Ibi byongera ubushobozi bwo kwiga no gutsinda mu ishuri.
knowledge.summary_en: Memory techniques help the brain retain and recall information quickly. Common methods include acronyms, visualization, and association. These strategies generally improve learning efficiency and academic performance.

knowledge.title_rw: Akamaro ko kumenya gukoresha ikoranabuhanga mu kwiga
knowledge.title_en: The role of digital literacy in modern learning
knowledge.summary_rw: Kumenya gukoresha ikoranabuhanga bifasha abanyeshuri kubona amakuru yizewe vuba. Bituma bashobora kwiga banyuze kuri murandasi no gukorana n'abandi bari ahandi. Ibi byongera ubumenyi n'ubushobozi bwabo mu isi y'ubu.
knowledge.summary_en: Digital literacy helps students access reliable information quickly. It enables them to learn online and collaborate with peers globally. This builds essential skills for the modern world.

knowledge.title_rw: Kwifatanya n'abandi mu matsinda yo kwiga
knowledge.summary_rw: Kwifatanya n'abandi mu matsinda yo kwiga bifasha abanyeshuri gusobanukirwa neza amasomo. Iyo abanyeshuri bungurana ibitekerezo, bashobora gutsinda neza ibizamini kuko buri wese yigira ku bandi.
knowledge.summary_en: Peer learning and study groups help students understand their subjects better. When students share ideas, they usually perform better in exams because everyone learns from each other.

knowledge.summary_rw: Ubuhanga bwo gushakisha amakuru bufasha abanyeshuri kubona amakuru yizewe. Ni ngombwa gusuzuma isoko y'amakuru kugira ngo umenye niba ari ukuri kandi bifite ireme.
knowledge.summary_en: Research skills help students find reliable information. It is important to evaluate the source of information to ensure that it is accurate and of high quality.

knowledge.summary_rw: Imikino ngororamubiri ni imwe mu mikino ya kera cyane. Irimo amasiganwa y'abiruka, gusimbuka no gutera. Abakinnyi bo mu Rwanda bitabira amarushanwa mpuzamahanga menshi.
knowledge.summary_en: Athletics is one of the oldest sports. It usually includes running events, jumping, and throwing. Athletes from Rwanda often participate in many international competitions.

knowledge.summary_rw: Gukirana ni umukino wa gakondo mu Rwanda. Abasore n'abagabo bitabiraga uyu mukino mu birori n'amasiganwa atandukanye. Byari uburyo bwo kwerekana imbaraga n'ubuhanga. Nanone kandi byafashaga mu kongera ubumwe n'ubucuti mu baturage.
knowledge.summary_en: Traditional wrestling is an ancient sport in Rwanda. Young men and adults usually participated in this game during ceremonies and various competitions. It was a method to demonstrate strength and skill. It also helped to build unity and friendship among citizens.

knowledge.title_rw: Umukino wa Handball mu mashuri n'amakipe
knowledge.summary_rw: Handball ni umukino ukinirwa mu Rwanda mu mashuri no mu makipe atandukanye. Uyu mukino ufasha abanyeshuri n'urubyiruko kugira ubuzima bwiza no guteza imbere impano zabo muri siporo.
knowledge.summary_en: Handball is a sport played in schools and various clubs in Rwanda. This game helps students and youth maintain good health and develop their sports talents.

knowledge.summary_rw: Iteramakofi ni umukino w'amarushanwa aho abakinnyi babiri barwana bakoresha amaboko yabo gusa. Abakinnyi bambara utuboko twabugenewe kugira ngo birinde ibikomere. Imyitozo y'ibanze irimo kwirinda, gutera amakofi, no kongera imbaraga n'ubudahangarwa bw'umubiri.
knowledge.summary_en: Boxing is a combat sport where two competitors fight using only their fists. Fighters wear specialized gloves to prevent injuries. Basic training usually involves defensive moves, throwing punches, and building overall physical strength and stamina.

knowledge.summary_rw: Umukino wa Tennis ukinishwa Racket na Tennis ball mu kibuga cyabugenewe. Abakinnyi bashaka gutsinda amanota binyuze mu kugarura umupira mu rubuga rw'uwo bahanganye. Umukino uyoborwa n'umusifuzi mukuru n'abasifuzi bo ku mirongo.
knowledge.summary_en: Tennis is played with rackets and a tennis ball on a rectangular court. Players score points by hitting the ball so the opponent cannot return it properly. The match is usually overseen by a chair umpire and line judges.

knowledge.title_en: Basic first aid for minor cuts
knowledge.summary_rw: Kubikuza igikomere cyoroheje ukoresha amazi meza n'isabune ni ingenzi. Kuraho umwanda wose ushobora gutera ubwandu. Shyiraho umuti wica udukoko n'igitambaro gikeye cyo guhagarika amaraso no kurinda igikomere.
knowledge.summary_en: Cleaning a minor cut with clean water and soap is important. Remove any dirt that could cause infection. Apply an antiseptic and a clean bandage to stop bleeding and protect the wound.

knowledge.summary_rw: Abanyamaguru bagomba kugendera ku ruhande rw'ibumoso rw'umuhanda iyo nta nzira yabo ihari. Bagomba kwambuka umuhanda ku micaca yabugenewe cyangwa aho abapolisi bari. Ni byiza kwitonda no kureba ibumoso n'iburyo mbere yo kwambuka.
knowledge.summary_en: Pedestrians usually need to walk on the left side of the road if there is no sidewalk. They should cross the road at designated crossings or where police direct traffic. It is important to look left and right carefully before crossing.

knowledge.summary_rw: Abakuze b'inyangamugayo bubaha umwana kandi ntibamusaba guhisha ibanga ribabaza. Abateza akaga basaba abana ibintu bidasanzwe cyangwa bakabakoraho mu buryo butera ipfunwe. Abana bagomba kubwira umuntu mukuru bizewe iyo hari uwagerageje kubagirira nabi.
knowledge.summary_en: Safe adults respect a child's boundaries and never ask them to keep harmful secrets. Unsafe adults often ask for inappropriate secrecy or touch children in uncomfortable ways. Children should always report unsafe behaviors to a trusted adult.

knowledge.title_rw: Gukoresha neza imiti yoza mu rugo nta byago
knowledge.title_en: Safe use of household cleaning products
knowledge.summary_rw: Imiti yoza mu rugo ishobora kuba mibi nidakoreshejwe neza. Ntuzavange imiti itandukanye nka jik na asidi kuko bitanga umwuka wica. Bika iyo miti ahantu abana n'amatungo batayigeza. Jya wambara amadarubina na rukoko igihe uyikoresha. Soma amabwiriza ku icupa mbere yo kuyikoresha.
knowledge.summary_en: Household cleaning products can be dangerous if misused. Never mix different cleaners like bleach and acids because they create toxic gases. Store chemicals safely out of reach of children and pets. Wear protective gloves and eye gear when necessary. Always read product labels before use.

knowledge.summary_rw: Ikinyarwanda gifite amabara y'ibanze atatu. Aya mabara ni umukara, umweru n'umutuku. Andi mabara menshi akomoka ku bintu bisanzwe biri mu bidukikije nka nyiramugengeri cyangwa ibyatsi. Imiterere y'amabara mu Kinyarwanda igaragaza uko abantu b'Abanyarwanda basobanura isi yabo.
knowledge.summary_en: Kinyarwanda traditionally has three primary color terms. These are black, white, and red. Many other color names derive from natural objects in the environment such as soil or grass. The structure of colors in Kinyarwanda reflects how Rwandan people describe their physical world.

knowledge.summary_rw: Gukuba ni uburyo bwo kongera umubare inshuro nyinshi. Kugabanya ni uburyo bwo kugabanya umubare mu bice bingana. Ibi bikorwa byombi bifitanye isano ya bugufi muri matematika. Gukuba bisohora umusaruro munini, naho kugabanya bigabanya uwo musaruro mu matsinda.
knowledge.summary_en: Multiplication is a way of adding a number multiple times. Division is the process of splitting a number into equal parts. These two operations are closely related in mathematics. Multiplication increases totals, while division separates totals into groups.

knowledge.title_rw: Imibare y'Igice n'Imibare ifite Agaciro k'Ikinjana
knowledge.summary_rw: Igice kigaragaza igice cy'umubare wuzuuye. Kimenyekana hifashishijwe umubare wo hejuru n'umubare wo hepfo. Umubare ufite agaciro k'ikinjana ukoresha akadomo kerekana ibice biri munsi y'umubare wuzuuye. Zombi zifashishwa mu mibare mu buzima bwa buri munsi.
knowledge.summary_en: A fraction represents a part of a whole number. It is written with a numerator and a denominator. A decimal uses a dot to show parts below a whole number. Both are used in math for everyday measurements.

knowledge.summary_rw: Ikomatanya n'imiterere ni ishami ry'imibare ryiga ku bushyikirane bw'ingingo, imirongo, ubuso n'ibice bifite uburebure, ubugari n'uburebure bw'imbere. Ifasha mu gusobanura isura n'aho ibintu biherereye mu mwanya.
knowledge.summary_en: Geometry is a branch of mathematics that studies the relationships of points, lines, surfaces, and solids with length, width, and depth. It helps in describing shapes and the positions of objects in space.

knowledge.summary_rw: Ubuso ni umubare w'aho ikintu gifata mu mwanya w'impande ebyiri. Umuringoti ni uburebure bwose bw'inkengero z'ikintu gifite impande ebyiri. Izi ngingo zifashishwa mu kubara ubutaka no mu bwubatsi.
knowledge.summary_en: Area is the amount of space inside a two-dimensional shape. Perimeter is the total distance around the outer boundary of a shape. These concepts are used in land measurement and construction.

knowledge.summary_rw: Impuzandengo y'imibare yitwa ariutimetike ibarwa iteranya imibare yose maze igabanishwa n'umubare wayo. Ni uburyo bwo kugaragaza agaciro gahuza cyangwa gasanzwe mu mibare runaka.
knowledge.summary_en: The arithmetic mean is calculated by adding all numbers in a set and dividing by the count of numbers. It is a common way to represent a typical value in a dataset.

knowledge.summary_rw: Inyungu ku nyungu ni uburyo amafaranga yiyongera cyane. Uteranya inyungu ku mari y'ibanze hamwe n'inyungu zimaze kwiyongeraho mbere. Ibi bituma umutungo ukura vuba mu gihe kirekire. Abashoramari n'abizigamira bakoresha ubu buryo kugira ngo bongere umutungo wabo.
knowledge.summary_en: Compound interest is the addition of interest to the principal sum of a loan or deposit. It means that the interest builds on previous interest over time. This causes wealth to grow faster over long periods. Investors and savers use this principle to maximize their financial returns.

knowledge.summary_rw: Gitegura amafaranga y'ihutirwa bifasha abantu kwitegura ibibazo by'imari bitunguranye nko kubura akazi cyangwa uburwayi. Abahanga benshi bagira inama yo kubika amafaranga ahwanye n'ibizatunga umuryango mu mezi atatu kugeza kuri atandatu. Aya mafaranga agomba kubikwa ahantu hizewe kandi ashobora kuboneka vuba.
knowledge.summary_en: Emergency fund planning helps individuals prepare for unexpected financial challenges such as job loss or illness. Many experts recommend saving an amount equivalent to three to six months of living expenses. These funds should be kept in a secure account that allows for quick access when needed.

knowledge.summary_rw: Amanota ya krediti ni imibare yerekana uko umuntu yitwara mu kwishyura inguzanyo ze. Iyi mibare ifasha amabanki n'ibigo by'imari mu gufata icyemezo cyo gutanga inguzanyo. Kugira amanota meza bisaba kwishyura ku gihe no kutarenza umipaka y'amafaranga wemerewe gukoresha.
knowledge.summary_en: A credit score is a numerical expression that evaluates a person's creditworthiness. Financial institutions use this score to determine loan eligibility. Maintaining a good credit score generally requires paying debts on time and managing credit utilization responsibly.

knowledge.title_rw: Ubumenyi bw'Ibanze bwo gutegura Igihe cy'ikiruhuko
knowledge.summary_rw: Gutegura igihe cy'ikiruhuko bisobanura kwizigamira amafaranga azakoreshwa igihe uzaba wahagaritse akazi. Bitangira hakiri kare kugira ngo inyungu y'amafaranga yizigamiye yiyongere. Abantu bitabira ibigo by'ubwizigame cyangwa imishinga y'ishoramari. Ibi bifasha abantu kugira imibereho myiza mu gihe cy'izabukuru badafite akazi k'umushahara.
knowledge.summary_en: Retirement planning involves saving money to support oneself after stopping work. Starting early allows investments to grow through compound interest. People often use pension funds or investment portfolios to secure their future. Proper planning helps individuals maintain financial stability during their later years when regular salary income stops.

knowledge.summary_rw: Ishoramari mu mitungo itimukwa risobanura kugura cyangwa gucunga amazu n'ubutaka hagamijwe kubona inyungu. Abashoramari bakunze kubona amafaranga binyuze mu bukode cyangwa mu kuzamuka kw'agaciro k'umutungo uko igihe gishira. Ni ishoramari risaba ubushishozi n'ishoramari ry'ibanze rihagije kugira ngo ritange umusaruro wifuzwa.
knowledge.summary_en: Real estate investing involves buying or managing properties to generate returns. Investors typically earn income through rental yields or property appreciation over time. This form of investment generally requires careful research and substantial initial capital to achieve desired financial goals.

knowledge.summary_rw: Gutegura imari y'umuryango bifasha gucunga neza amafaranga no kugera ku ntego z'igihe kirekire. Byubakwa no gushyiraho ingengo y'imari, kuzigama, no kwitegura ibihe bitunguranye.
knowledge.summary_en: Family financial planning helps manage money effectively and achieve long-term goals. It usually involves budgeting, saving, and preparing for unexpected emergencies.
